headline: Ikea’s Xbox collection includes a giant thumbstick stool
summary: Ikea partnered with Microsoft to launch a new line of gaming-inspired furniture. The Yxstaby collection marks the 25th anniversary of the first Xbox console. Standout items include a unique giant thumbstick stool and other accessories.

headline: Garmin’s new Fenix 9 adds brighter screens and smoother map panning
summary: Garmin unveiled its new Fenix 9 smartwatches featuring a significantly brighter OLED display. The screen boasts up to 3,000 nits, making it twice as bright as its predecessor. The Fenix 9 also offers 50% more RAM and starts at $999.99.

headline: Trump is upping the price of Big Tech’s favorite visa
summary: The Department of Homeland Security announced a new fee exceeding $103,000 for H-1B visas. The State Department also plans to revoke visas for up to 200,000 asylum seekers. These measures are set to impact legal immigration and the tech industry.

headline: At just $8, you owe it to yourself to grab Inscryption
summary: Daniel Mullins, creator of the upcoming 'Pony Island 2,' has a previous hit with Inscryption. Humble is currently offering the unique deckbuilder game for only $8 on Steam. It's a fantastic deal to experience the bizarre and secret-packed title.

headline: Fable: After Watching a Full Quest, I Couldn’t Be More Excited to Play It | gamescom 2026
summary: A full quest from the highly anticipated Fable game was previewed at Gamescom 2026. The preview showcased an immersive world filled with 'beer, swearing, and aggressive strangers.' The reviewer expressed immense excitement and eagerness to play the full game.

headline: Xbox and IKEA Furniture Collaboration Includes Thumbstick Stools, Tables, and D-Pad Accessories
summary: IKEA has revealed an official furniture collaboration with Xbox, inspired by gaming. The new range includes various gaming chairs, display stands, and home accessories. Notable items feature unique thumbstick stools and cozy D-pad cushions.

headline: LEGO Super Mario Minifigure Sets Unveiled, Including Bowser's Castle and Mario Kart
summary: LEGO has finally unveiled its new Super Mario range, introducing minifigures for the first time. The collection features iconic playsets, including a detailed Bowser's Castle. Fans can also look forward to various Mario Kart vehicles in LEGO form.

headline: Persona 4 Revival: The Good and the Bad of Our First Hands-On – Gamescom 2026
summary: A first hands-on preview of Persona 4 Revival was shared from Gamescom 2026. The initial experience suggests the game strongly retains the beloved feel of the original Persona 4. Its true worth as a revival will be judged by its long-term appeal.

headline: From 'dirt poor' to philanthropic superstar - the life of Dolly Parton
summary: Iconic country musician Dolly Parton has passed away at the age of 80. Her team announced the sad news via social media channels. The article celebrates her remarkable life journey from humble beginnings to a celebrated philanthropist.

headline: Household energy bills to hit three-year high as Ofgem announces 4% rise from October
summary: Ofgem has announced a 4% increase in household energy bills, effective from October. This rise will add an extra £60 per year for a typical household. Energy costs are set to reach a three-year high.

headline: Dad of woman who took her own life says Treasury failed in its duty of care
summary: Chloe Moffat died by suicide last year following allegations of sharing confidential information. Her father asserts that the Treasury failed in its duty of care. Chloe had vehemently denied all allegations against her.

headline: Yellow warnings remain in force as rain and thunderstorms hit parts of UK
summary: Yellow weather warnings are still active across parts of England and Wales. Regions are experiencing torrential downpours and thunderstorms. This period marks some of the wettest weather seen in several weeks.
